assessment: The demonstration of the hemophilic adhesion molecule CD31's localization to the migrating neutrophil's uropod and required signaling through its ITIM domain are valuable findings. Convincing evidence now includes defective extravasation of CD31 ITIM motif-deleted neutrophils in adoptive transfer experiments. Based on the critical role of leukocyte transmigration in many physiologic and pathologic processes, this work will be of interest to a broad audience.
